members.name: avatar
members.doc: A small leading visual for the footer, such as the owner's avatar.

members.name: meta
members.doc: Who the card belongs to, such as the owner's name.

members.name: status
members.doc: A short status under the meta, such as "Updated 2 hours ago". Changed words rise in and are announced politely.

members.name: details
members.doc: Content for a quick look. When set, the whole card opens and grows into a larger view; Escape or the close control morphs it back.

members.name: container
members.doc: Opens the quick look inside this element instead of over the whole page: the dim covers only the element and the quick look centers in it. The element needs position: relative and overflow: hidden. The page around it stays usable while the quick look is open: nothing is scroll-locked or hidden from assistive technology, and Escape, the dim and the close control still close it.
